trials.notes: IC Retention +16.6%p. Effective breadth now honest (4-6 vs 24 claimed). Linear theme0=0.050, theme1=0.026 competitive with CatBoost 0.057-0.068

trials.description: A3: Remove short CatBoostRanker (use 1-alpha_long). B1: Triple-barrier labels (TP=1/SL=0/time=0.5) + Newey-West SE=True. B2: CS market-neutral demeaning integrated in triple-barrier
trials.notes: CRITICAL: CatBoost 9/9 fail DSR with triple-barrier labels. Linear baseline 2/3 survive. Root cause: discrete 3-value labels create 50% uninformative pairs in YetiRank pairwise loss. Newey-West SE correctly exposed label inflation (IS t-stat overstated). Decision: tune barrier pt_multiplier 1.5→2.5, switch to RMSE loss, or commit to linear-first architecture.

decision_points.current: v9.0.3 marginal (2 survivors, both linear). Choose: (1) Tune barrier to reduce neutral label %, (2) RMSE loss for discrete labels, (3) Linear-first engine, (4) Rollback to v9.0.2 and abandon triple-barrier
